name: THE_FATHER
canonical: the father of the prodigal, an aged Near-Eastern patriarch of about seventy, sun-darkened olive skin, a deeply lined dignified face, long flowing white hair and a full white beard, brimming tearful eyes, wearing a long fine layered robe of warm ochre and a head-cloth with the hem hiked up in his hand as he runs with both arms flung wide open
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
